FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A01
Gaps run two seconds at thirty miles per hour or less and four seconds above, with beginners holding four always and fixed-object checks catching tailgaters [A01].
Why it matters: group following-gaps; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A01
Reaction alone eats one and a half seconds, while full stops stretch from sixty-three feet at twenty miles per hour to three hundred eighty-seven at seventy [A01].
Why it matters: group stopping-distance; difficulty medium; prereq sec08-F01; confusables sec08-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A01
Wet, crowded, and blind roads each earn slower wider driving, and darkness forbids outdriving headlight vision [A01].
Why it matters: group speed-adjustment; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A01
Sight fields fall from full width standing still to two-thirds at twenty, two-fifths at forty, and one-fifth at sixty miles per hour [A01].
Why it matters: group vision; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A02
Surface caps read thirty urban and fifteen alley or beach, highway caps read seventy or sixty numbered and sixty or fifty unnumbered with school-bus steps down, and freeways often post seventy-five to eighty-five [A02].
Why it matters: group speed-limits; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec08-F06, sec08-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A02
Lit work and rescue stops demand twenty below the limit or a lane away, while mail and trash stops want caution and room [A02].
Why it matters: group move-over; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F08, sec08-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A02
Five racing forms stay banned from plain races through exhibitions and records, with penalties spanning Class B misdemeanor to second-degree felony [A02].
Why it matters: group street-racing; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0052]
